mentions.name: mpcButtonJukebox
mentions.description: A Raspberry Pi-powered jukebox program that recreates the traditional jukebox experience: a numpad is used to input song numbers, which are looked up from a list, sent to MPD for playback, with the album art embedded in the music file displayed. Built to work on Raspberry Pi 5 and the current Raspberry Pi OS.
mentions.problem: Existing Raspberry Pi jukebox conversion projects mostly used a touch screen or didn't work well on Raspberry Pi 5 or the current Raspberry Pi OS, and none offered traditional button-based song number input.
mentions.source_excerpt: So despite not being a programmer, barely knowing a little javascript, and nothing about python, linux, or gtk, I was able to use AI to muddle my way through to creating a program that takes the input from a numpad, looks up the song from a list, sends it to mpd, and posts a picture from the album art embedded in the music file. https://github.com/jccalhoun/mpcButtonJukebox
